1. We love to read about celebrities' problems, which the media will often invent.
2. There are even shows that pay for plastic surgery.
Grammar extra
Defining and non-defining relative clauses
See page 146.
Defining relative clauses define, identify, or give essential information about a noun.
There are shows that/which payfor plastic surgery.
We love to read about the people (who/that) celebrities date and the clothes (that) they wear.
Non-defining relative clauses give extra information about a noun.
In conversation..
They do not begin with that. Notice the use of commas.
That is more common than which in
Celebrity magazines, which outnumber news magazines, are everywhere.
defining relative clauses.
It's natural totalk about celebrities, who we see assuccessful people
Non-defining and which clauses often
give opinions as well as information.
A which clause can add information ora comment tothe clause before it.
This obsession is normal, which is reassuring
Commonerrors
Celebrities come into ourhomes,which almost makes them family
Do not use which for people, or
what in relative clauses.
